versions.changelog: 默认返回最终采集结果，完善异步等待下载与安全恢复；修复空目标误执行、Quick Start、Token 配置和触发路由冲突，并补齐发布前自动化测试
新增能力路由与异步任务闭环，修复失效引用、Token 泄漏和 Skill 元数据兼容性
补全中文文档，更新目录结构

Initial release.

- Introduces the dataify-google-flights skill to turn Google Flights user requests into Dataify Scraper API form submissions.
- Implements a mandatory pre-call confirmation workflow with Markdown table preview and user parameter confirmation before every API call.
- Default values are applied only when explicitly stated in parameter descriptions; placeholder or example values are never used as defaults.
- Includes token validation and prompts users to sign in for a token if missing, before any API call.
- Enforces mapping and normalization rules for fields such as route, trip type, travel class, and output format.
- Returns API responses directly without modification or summarization.
